text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*..., *gasp*. Trainer, 
what's the clock say...?!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, not bad... We can definitely compete 
with this.

Yeah, not bad... We can definitely compete 
with this.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
~~...gh! Really?! You think I can make 
it?! Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrr~~)

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho-ho. I hear Tracen Academy has a 
cafeteria, is that right?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"To build a strong body, you need proper 
nutrition. Go on and eat pl~enty of food."
choice_data_list:
I'll text you the ingredients I want you 
to eat, too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Let's see, sardines, wood ear 
mushrooms, and~...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Understood! Here I go~!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho-ho... ...Well then, we shall take 
our leave.
choice_data_list: Can I consult you about a current concern?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Let's think through any problem 
together.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —Tsuru-chan! What video is that?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: The Satsuki Sho! President Rudolf's race!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Did you know? Even President Rudolf, who 
seemed so invincible and strong ever since 
her debut race... she had a wall to 
overcome before the Satsuki Sho too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Can you believe that at the Yayoi Sho 
right before the Satsuki Sho, my rival 
took away my spot as the first favorite?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"And even in the actual Satsuki Sho, the 
popularity was split right down the middle 
between that Umamusume and the President. 
There were all kinds of predictions right 
up until the start, but..."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the President beat her 
opponent! "Absolute" really was absolute 
after all!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—That's why I'll overcome it too. No 
matter what wall stands before me in the 
Satsuki Sho. I will triumph over that 
wall!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Just because you said so, do you really 
think we're just going to back down?"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I don't think that at all!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: That's why I want to win!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —...Zzz... *snore*... *wheeze*...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ow, ow...— ......—It itches...—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: ...That's a terrible case of hives.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Because of that, I had such a hard 
time falling asleep!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, when this 
happened in the past, I was prescribed 
oral medication...
choice_data_list:
...Hold on, there's the withdrawal period 
to consider.

...Wait, there's the withdrawal period to 
consider.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I count down the days on the calendar 
until the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even with medicine that is normally fine 
to take, if traces remain in her system on 
race day... it will be treated as doping.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru-san. By the way, does anything 
else hurt?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Please tell me the symptoms in detail. 
...We want to look into what we can do to 
help.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...It doesn't hurt that badly, but my 
arms feel kind of prickly..."

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's stress-related or something 
else... Pain of an unknown origin, huh...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: B-But still! I'm well enough to talk!!
choice_data_list: —! ...Yeah, that's right!
—! ...Yeah, you're right!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right. Yeah, let's take all the 
precautions we can."
choice_data_list:
First, I'm going to change our planned 
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ! Yes!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let us do our very best. We'll 
hold our ground until the very end of the 
day~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clatter, clunk, clatter, clunk...)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah!? Sensei, Trainer!? What on earth is 
that machine...!?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho-ho. This is the ultrasound 
diagnostic device we used to use at our 
clinic.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Let's check with this to see if there's 
any inflammation~. I won't let your limits 
go unnoticed~.
choice_data_list: Tsuyoshi, we've got your back
Tsuyoshi, we're here for you

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ngggh! Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
All right, Tsuyoshi! I'm off for the 800m 
run!!
choice_data_list: Oh, I'm timing you, too, so get ready!
Yeah, I'm timing you, so don't worry!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"If she passes on the Satsuki Sho now... 
she'll never get another chance to run in 
it again, right?"

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume only gets one chance in her 
entire life to challenge the Classic 
Triple Crown, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Deyaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi takes off from the 
starting line. Her time is—
choice_data_list: —Eh?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*..., Trainer, how was 
thatâ
choice_data_list: ...It's slower by 0.5 seconds.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? If it's only about 0.5 seconds... 
Maybe it'll be different if we time it 
again?
choice_data_list:
...Ngh, th-that might be true! Let's try 
one more time!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And taking breaks along the way, we timed 
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's runs."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That evening. The next day. And the day 
after that. But—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we need to start cutting back on 
training soon. If we're heading into the 
real race, that is...
choice_data_list: That may be true, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An average time delay of 0.5 seconds. In a 
race, that leads to a fatal gap.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is often said that 0.2 seconds equals a 
margin of 1 horse length. If so, then this 
is not within the margin of error...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Do you have a moment to talk?
choice_data_list: Yeah... What is it, Tsuyoshi?
Yeah... What is it, Tsuyoshi?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Let's forego running in the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: What?! Tsurumaru-san, why are you—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The conditions, the location, the 
distance—I kept everything identical for 
my solo run. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—My whole body is itching and prickling. I 
couldn't ignore it, and I just couldn't 
focus.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I know what kind of outcome those 0.5 
seconds will bring in the real race.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The "competitive" version of me that 
Trainer talked about before was much 
faster than I am now.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
As I am now, it wouldn't even be a contest 
against my peers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swallowing down the judgment she had made 
for herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I grit my teeth at the fact that I forced 
her to make that decision.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—But precisely because my classmates are 
so strong! I want to train hard and become 
able to win, too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Because what I want to become is an 
Umamusume who is "unquestionably strong"!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Nakayama Racecourse is packed to the 
brim! And no wonder—today marks the 
opening day of the Classic Triple Crown!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The Umamusume gathered for the Satsuki 
Sho strike sparks as they contest the 
glorious first crown!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"‘The main focus is, of course, the clash 
of the "Big Three." Each has garnered 
tremendous support from the gathered 
crowd.’"

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
"It's no exaggeration to say the winner 
will come from these three. A clash of 
true titans!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho. She and I were 
in the trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Did you know? The Satsuki Sho is 
won by the fastest Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Still, the one I idolized wasn't the 
fastest Umamusume! It was Symboli 
Rudolf—the Umamusume who proved her 
absolute supremacy on the track!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm certain of it. Even if the 
President hadn't won the Satsuki Sho."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I certainly—looked up to that person.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I'm gonna get stronger too! In 
mind and body! Just like the President!"
choice_data_list:
Yeah, absolutely! ...Let's become stronger 
this time!

Yeah, definitely!... Let's become stronger 
this time!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes! You can definitely do it!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Alright, today I'm gonna gather heaps of 
data on our rivals!

text_block_list.name: TV Cheering
text_block_list.text: "WAAAAAAAAAAAH--!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"In the lead is Seiun Sky! It's Seiun Sky! 
She went all the way wire-to-wire!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Holding off the fierce pursuit of King 
Halo and Special Week, Seiun Sky captures 
the Satsuki Sho!!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —...Waaah...! Amazing, amazing, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Sei-chan, King-chan, and Spe-chan too! By 
the end, it was completely a three-way 
race!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —I will come to defeat all three of them.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
At the Derby, the dream stage everyone 
longs for.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Definitely. —Just like President Rudolf.
